title: Ellipsis & substitution
note: so/neither do I; one/ones; omit repeated VPs · thin shell night/2026-08-05

items.en: I like coffee and so does she.
items.cz: Mám rád kávu a ona taky.
items.gap: I like coffee and so ____ she.
accepts: I like coffee and so does she.

items.en: I don't agree, and neither do they.
items.gap: I don't agree, and neither ____ they.
accepts: I don't agree, and neither do they.

items.en: I'd like the blue one, please.
accepts: I'd like the blue one, please.

items.en: She can swim better than I can.
items.gap: She can swim better than I ____.
accepts: She can swim better than I can.
items.explanation: Ellipsis of main verb after modal.

items.en: If you can help, please do.
items.cz: Pokud můžeš pomoct, prosím udělej to.
accepts: If you can help, please do.

items.en: A: Coming tonight? B: Hope so.
items.cz: A: Přijdeš dnes? B: Doufám, že jo.
accepts: A: Coming tonight? B: Hope so.

items.en: He said he would call, but he didn't.
items.gap: He said he would call, but he ____.
accepts: He said he would call, but he didn't.

items.en: These shoes are nicer than those ones.
items.cz: Tyhle boty jsou hezčí než tyhle.
items.gap: These shoes are nicer than those ____.
accepts: These shoes are nicer than those ones.

items.en: I thought she was ready, but she wasn't.
items.cz: Myslel jsem, že je připravená, ale nebyla.
items.gap: I thought she was ready, but she ____.
accepts: I thought she was ready, but she wasn't.
